final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and its extra lines, filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC ISO format, extracted message and exception (last traceback line or null), and counted repeats from the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Summed repeat counts per service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
